memory_candidates.content: When adding a new post-postflight stage to skill-orchestrate, the stage's executable body must NOT be written inline in skills/skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md. verify-deploy.sh gate 9 runs scripts/lint/lint-postflight-boundary.sh, which scans skill SKILL.md content appearing AFTER a postflight section for Edit-on-source, build-command, and MCP patterns. Any stage that legitimately performs those operations and sits textually after Move 3 (Postflight) will trip it. The established workaround is the single-executable-block pattern already used by context/patterns/lit-stage4a-flow.md: site the body in a context/ contract or pattern file and leave SKILL.md only a short pointer stanza. This keeps the lint's general predicate intact rather than manufacturing an exemption, and matches the codebase's existing lazy-pointer context style.
